visualCharacteristics: Expand/collapse accordion with a plus/minus-circle toggle. Each panel holds prose, document links, or buttons. PDF links in links mode include a PDF icon and accessible file-type label.
contentPattern: One row per category: cell 1 = title, cell 2 = content, optional cell 3 = link style (links, buttons, or auto). Blank or auto preserves the shared link decoration. Inline links in sentences remain inline in buttons mode.
usage: Categorized document directories (e.g. reimbursement policies, medical policies) presented as collapsible sections.
